title: millis(): timing and button input without delay

spans.text: `delay` prevents other work during the wait. `millis()` returns elapsed milliseconds; compare elapsed time to schedule LED, sensor, and communication work cooperatively. Unsigned subtraction handles counter rollover.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: `millis()` is not a hard real-time guarantee. Use a suitable hardware timer, interrupt, or RTOS mechanism when deadlines require it.
